name: Easy Sheet Pan Crispy Calamari with Roasted Broccoli, Cauliflower & Marinara Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and zest lemon into a large bowl. Add oil and spices, then stir to combine. (Cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
⅜ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broccoli and cauliflower to the bowl with the lemon-spice oil, then toss to combine. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place baking sheet in the preheated oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.

Meanwhile, transfer calamari to another large baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. When the veggies have 10 minutes left, add calamari to the oven; bake, turning halfway, until cooked through, 10-15 minutes. (Reserve marinara sauce for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (283 g) pkg breaded calamari with marinara, frozen

instructions.primary_message: While the calamari is baking, place marinara sauce in a small saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, then remove from heat, cover, and set aside.
Divide calamari and veggies between plates. Serve with marinara for dipping and lemon wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
